about.registryInfo: ST0x describes S01 Issuer GmbH as the regulated issuer of its tokenized equities. An April 2026 ST0x-related release describes S01 Issuer GmbH as a German limited liability company issuing tokens as debt instruments under an EU Base Prospectus approved by Liechtenstein's FMA on 30 Mar 2026. The ST0x FAQ spells the issuer as "S1 Issuer GmbH". SARK X (BVI) Ltd / SarkX BVI Ltd operates the website and decentralized matching engine.
